select.title: Choose prosumer supply points
select.description: History is downloaded daily from this fixed start date. Confirmed data only by default. Enable estimates to include uncertain and forecast values; missing values are excluded.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the E.ON session
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in again in your browser and paste a fresh Cookie header for the same account.

cookie.title: Advanced: paste a Cookie header
cookie.description: Log in at eon.pl/mojeon, then copy the Cookie request header from a successful GetPHList request in browser developer tools. This session secret is stored locally in Home Assistant. Automatic password login is not supported.

browser.title: Browser sign-in
browser.description: Install the [Chrome sign-in extension](https://github.com/tukies/home-assistant-eon-polska#browser-sign-in-recommended), open your normal E.ON tab and sign in with your email and password. Click Copy session code in the extension, then paste it below. The code is a secret; no developer tools are needed.

reauth_browser.title: Renew browser sign-in
reauth_browser.description: Install the [Chrome sign-in extension](https://github.com/tukies/home-assistant-eon-polska#browser-sign-in-recommended), open your normal E.ON tab and sign in with your email and password. Click Copy session code in the extension, then paste it below. The code is a secret; no developer tools are needed.

error.invalid_auth: The browser session is invalid or expired.
error.wrong_account: This session cannot access all configured supply points.
error.invalid_selection: Choose accessible supply points and a start date from 2022 to two days ago.
error.invalid_session_code: This is not a valid session code. Open the sign-in extension on your E.ON tab, click Copy session code, and paste it here.

abort.no_oze_accounts: No active prosumer supply points were found. Standard electricity accounts are not supported by this report endpoint.
abort.already_configured: One or more supply points are already configured.
